dedupe_keys.name: modelling outputs of the awesome water supply model of the nile river basin

description: Veronica Piuri at Politecnico di Milano publishes AWESOME water-supply simulation outputs covering the Nile basin. The March 2024 deposit includes water-level trajectories for the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance, Merowe and High Aswan dams, plus release trajectories for GERD and High Aswan. Text files compare historical water availability and demand with 2050 climate and demographic scenarios using RCP4.5 and SSP2. Named solutions emphasise basin hydropower, irrigation deficits in Egypt or Sudan, and alternative water reductions. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. Exact timesteps, physical units, historical years and optimisation weights remain unknown from the page. These trajectories can benchmark water-allocation simulations and examine scenario trade-offs; they are modelled outcomes, not dam-operation observations. Some scenario labels have overlapping descriptions and require clarification before comparison. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies these output files, and their contents were not downloaded.
